reading: scope: only a one-nearest-neighbour rule and a 5-medoid rule over coarsened ATC, mechanism, target and indication facts were tried. This does not bound learned predictors, generated structures, richer facts or free-text profiles, and failing to reject zero is not equivalence: an interval shows which gains the data rule out, not that there is none. Intervals are descriptive for this fixed population and these fixed rules (nothing is refit per resample).

component-matched, all drugs (n=1786, 771 components): facts-kNN 0.163 cannot be told apart from the central constant 0.169 (paired -0.006 [-0.011, +0.001]; compatible with gains up to +0.001) and beats the Train-fixed constant 0.146 (paired +0.017 [+0.012, +0.022]); 5-medoid 0.164 cannot be told apart from the central constant 0.169 (paired -0.005 [-0.011, +0.002]; compatible with gains up to +0.002) and beats the Train-fixed constant 0.146 (paired +0.018 [+0.012, +0.024])

component-matched, Train drugs only (n=231, 194 components): facts-kNN 0.174 falls below the central constant 0.188 (paired -0.014 [-0.024, -0.004]) and falls below the Train-fixed constant 0.185 (paired -0.011 [-0.021, -0.001]); 5-medoid 0.181 cannot be told apart from the central constant 0.188 (paired -0.007 [-0.016, +0.002]; compatible with gains up to +0.002) and cannot be told apart from the Train-fixed constant 0.185 (paired -0.004 [-0.013, +0.005]; compatible with gains up to +0.005)

component-matched, first approved 2015 or later (n=251, 212 components): facts-kNN 0.168 falls below the central constant 0.181 (paired -0.013 [-0.022, -0.003]) and cannot be told apart from the Train-fixed constant 0.175 (paired -0.007 [-0.016, +0.002]; compatible with gains up to +0.002); 5-medoid 0.176 cannot be told apart from the central constant 0.181 (paired -0.005 [-0.015, +0.007]; compatible with gains up to +0.007) and cannot be told apart from the Train-fixed constant 0.175 (paired +0.002 [-0.008, +0.012]; compatible with gains up to +0.012)

pairwise-matched, all drugs (n=1786, 771 components): facts-kNN 0.201 beats the central constant 0.169 (paired +0.032 [+0.015, +0.051]) and beats the Train-fixed constant 0.146 (paired +0.055 [+0.035, +0.075]); 5-medoid 0.198 beats the central constant 0.169 (paired +0.029 [+0.013, +0.046]) and beats the Train-fixed constant 0.146 (paired +0.051 [+0.033, +0.071])

pairwise-matched, Train drugs only (n=231, 194 components): facts-kNN 0.190 cannot be told apart from the central constant 0.188 (paired +0.001 [-0.012, +0.014]; compatible with gains up to +0.014) and cannot be told apart from the Train-fixed constant 0.185 (paired +0.004 [-0.011, +0.019]; compatible with gains up to +0.019); 5-medoid 0.194 cannot be told apart from the central constant 0.188 (paired +0.006 [-0.007, +0.019]; compatible with gains up to +0.019) and cannot be told apart from the Train-fixed constant 0.185 (paired +0.009 [-0.005, +0.023]; compatible with gains up to +0.023)

any, all drugs (n=1786, 771 components): facts-kNN 0.273 beats the central constant 0.169 (paired +0.104 [+0.075, +0.134]) and beats the Train-fixed constant 0.146 (paired +0.126 [+0.094, +0.159]); 5-medoid 0.269 beats the central constant 0.169 (paired +0.100 [+0.069, +0.132]) and beats the Train-fixed constant 0.146 (paired +0.123 [+0.088, +0.157])
in short, with whole components kept apart: over all drugs the facts-kNN beats one constant but not the other, over Train drugs it falls below both constants; the other two rules are in the tables.
